title: NOQTIS: Notary Of Quantum-safe Traceable Inputs and Seals
description: NOQTIS is a C11 library and command-line tool, with no dependencies, that seals a folder of files (the exact data, code and outputs behind a result) with a post-quantum signature, so that anyone can check later, offline, that every file is unchanged, that nothing was added or removed, and which key sealed it. It implements ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205), ML-KEM (FIPS 203), HQC, SHA-2 and SHA-3, tested against the NIST ACVP and Wycheproof test vectors.
